name: @omnigateway/pokemon
description: A Pokémon companion for OmniGateway. Each gateway key raises one that hatches, evolves, and graduates into a Pokédex on the tokens that key spends.
author: Harismawan <mail@harismawan.com>

scripts.build:server: bun build src/server.ts --outfile dist/pokemon/server/index.js --target bun --format esm
scripts.build:ui: NODE_ENV=production bun build ui/index.tsx --outfile dist/pokemon/ui/index.js --target browser --format esm --production --external react --external react-dom --external 'react/jsx-runtime' --external styled-components --external '@tanstack/react-query'
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:server && bun run build:ui && bun scripts/build-package.ts
